decisions.statement: Whether a seat states an assignment says nothing about whether that seat is idle.
A transcript's modification time moves when no work has been done.
The only licence to stop a seat with no initiative row is a claim carried on its own last send.
A seat can end its turn having narrated an act that seat never took.

definition: a seat whose process is live and whose work has stopped

members.definition: the seat's task names no initiative status, so nothing observable ends it
the seat reads its dispatched initiative as running while its file still stands
the last words are a request to log in again
the seat fell silent short of hand-back, so what it states is honestly unfinished
the seat said it was stopping, and the command that would stop it never ran
the work reads finished, and a child resident for its own reason is read ahead
